desc: Ideation: median-of-q formulation (q[i] = p[i] - i, answer = sum |q[i] - median|) verified against all three samples.

Write the complete Python solution: read N and S from stdin, compute 0-indexed positions of '1's, build q[i] = p[i] - i, sort q, take median m = q[k//2], print sum |q[i] - m|. Include fast I/O via sys.stdin.
Verify edge cases: single '1' (answer 0), already-contiguous ones (answer 0), all ones (answer 0).
